shared_elements: human figure represented frontally or in profile on a stone surface
headdress / head-covering rendered as a distinct block above the head
carved relief detail on a torso/body
curvilinear motifs (rosettes in A, concentric circles/loops in B)
justification: Both surfaces depict anthropomorphic figures with prominent headgear and shallow-carved surface ornament, and both include roundel-like curvilinear motifs (rosettes in A, concentric circle/loop forms in B), but this is generic. A shows a narrative procession of several profile figures interacting, holding staffs and objects, framed above and below by continuous bands of identical rosettes, whereas B is a single frontal, columnar figure whose body carries isolated abstract emblems with no scene, no interaction and no framing bands; the rendering conventions (fine linear naturalistic detail vs blocky schematic mass) are also quite different.
